audit_summary: The supplied Perplexity packet claimed TEMPORAL INTEGRITY: PASS but visibly exposed J11 outcomes in its source list, including a title with America 4-1 Pumas and another title stating Xolos ended Cruz Azul's unbeaten run. J11 is therefore permanently NO-PROMOTION.
The supplied post-J10 standings and several last-five rows contradict the already frozen J9 state plus canonical J10 settlement. They are rejected as model/stat inputs.
Canonical pre-J11 standings are reconstructed deterministically from the frozen J9 table and the canonical J10 result grid.
Only one complete same-book 1X2 row from the packet is accepted for mechanical price research: Juarez-Leon Bet365, sourced from a Sep.25 pre-match preview.
